rationale: All 12 genuine findings are resolved; CR-007 was dismissed after an experiment refuted its premise rather than being fixed on the reviewer's word. Two fixes were verified adversarially by reintroducing the original defect and confirming the new test fails: the request-body shape (CR-001) and, for CR-007, the render probe that refuted it. No new high-risk issue appeared in the fix-up diff, so no confirmation pass was needed. Verification after the fixes: backend 5179 passed with 2 pre-existing failures unrelated to this change (codemie_enterprise is not installed locally), ruff clean, license headers clean; frontend 1085 unit tests and 7 new integration tests pass, tsc clean, eslint clean apart from the repository's known broken alias resolver.
